hook: Aria's phone lights up mid-signature: her sister's clinic is named as collateral in the merger she is about to sign.

acts.summary: setup: Aria is about to sign, sees the collateral clause
confrontation: Aria confronts the rival who buried the clause
reversal: Aria turns the rival's own leverage against him, cliffhanger follows

beats.summary: Aria discovers the clinic-collateral clause mid-signing

power_shift.how: none — rival still controls the information

beats.summary: Aria confronts the rival; he mocks her, certain she has no move

power_shift.how: rival openly confirms he planned this, believing Aria is cornered

beats.summary: Aria reveals she already transferred the clinic out of the collateral pool an hour earlier

power_shift.how: the clause the rival weaponized is now void; Aria's calm reveal flips who is exposed

beats.summary: the rival scrambles to call his backers, but Aria's assistant confirms the board already knows he overreached

power_shift.how: Aria's earlier move keeps compounding against the rival

scene_dialogue_summary.summary: signing interrupted by the collateral reveal
Aria reveals the clinic is already out of reach
scene_dialogue_summary.key_line: You should have checked the transfer log before you smiled.

cliffhanger: As Aria walks out, her assistant whispers that the rival's own backers just called an emergency vote — the reversal she pulled off has put his own board on his neck next.
